cross_cutting_findings.signs_defensible: All four D-033 direction signs (producers +, processors -) are defensible on PIT evidence.
cross_cutting_findings.P_Q_not_separable: A separate own-volume Q term is NOT PIT-reproducible: planted area by crop x UF x vintage and hedge percents are declared gaps. Per docs/14 sec.3 and docs/13 sec.7, absence is treated as an identification limit, not filled. -> keep D-033 matrix (option 1), do not decompose into an explicit P/Q/C score.
cross_cutting_findings.materiality_attenuated: Effective grain materiality is attenuated for every name by non-primary crops (cane/cotton/beef), hedging/pre-sale, and geography partly outside the Shock (PI/Paraguay for AGRO3; MA/PI/PA for SLC; US/Europe feed for JBS).
cross_cutting_findings.producer_net_conditioned_on_H2a: Own-volume Q is partly outside the Shock, so P tends to dominate for producers, but the net sign is not resolvable by fundamentals -> the long side is conditioned on H2a (price transmission). If H2a fails, the long side is reformulated. This addresses R20 by evidence, not presumption.
cross_cutting_findings.universe_unchanged: No new direct name emerged; D-033 vetoes hold. The universe is genuinely 2 longs / 2 shorts (1 long before 03/2018). R19 (concentration/cap) is NOT resolved by the audit and remains open for the portfolio decision; the audit confirms concentration cannot be diluted by adding direct names.
